You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/infiniband/core/nldev.c`**
   - The line `rdma_restrack_put(res);` that was previously placed before the error handling (`if (ret) goto err_free;`) has been removed.
   - The same function call `rdma_restrack_put(res);` has been moved to after the error check, ensuring that the reference count of the resource tracker object is only decreased once in the error flow.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification addresses a bug related to the double decrement of the reference count for the resource tracker object in the `res_get_common_doit` function. By moving the `rdma_restrack_put(res);` call to occur only after confirming that there is no error (i.e., after the `if (ret)` check), the patch prevents the potential issue of incorrectly managing the reference count, which could lead to resource leaks or premature resource deallocation. This change ensures that the resource tracker is only released once, maintaining proper resource management.

content: You are a programming expert.

You will be given the root cause of a bug, the commit message and the corresponding patch.
        You need to extract all code statements that lead to the bug from the patch, based on the root cause and the commit message.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the `rdma_restrack_put(res);` function being called twice in the error flow of the `res_get_common_doit` function, leading to a double decrement of the reference count for the resource tracker object. This improper management of the reference count could result in resource leaks or premature deallocation of resources, potentially causing instability or crashes in the system.
        
        Commit message:
        RDMA/core: Fix double put of resource

Do not decrease the reference count of resource tracker object twice in
the error flow of res_get_common_doit.

Fixes: c5dfe0ea6ffa ("RDMA/nldev: Add resource tracker doit callback")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200507062942.98305-1-leon@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Maor Gottlieb <maorg@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leonro@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Jason Gunthorpe <jgg@mellanox.com>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/core/nldev.c b/drivers/infiniband/core/nldev.c
index 9eec26d10d7b..e16105be2eb2 100644
--- a/drivers/infiniband/core/nldev.c
+++ b/drivers/infiniband/core/nldev.c
@@ -1292,11 +1292,10 @@ static int res_get_common_doit(struct sk_buff *skb, struct nlmsghdr *nlh,
 	has_cap_net_admin = netlink_capable(skb, CAP_NET_ADMIN);
 
 	ret = fill_func(msg, has_cap_net_admin, res, port);
-
-	rdma_restrack_put(res);
 	if (ret)
 		goto err_free;
 
+	rdma_restrack_put(res);
 	nlmsg_end(msg, nlh);
 	ib_device_put(device);
 	return rdma_nl_unicast(sock_net(skb->sk), msg, NETLINK_CB(skb).portid);
